subject: Request: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week
messages:
From: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@speedbuy.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Li <michael.li@speedbuy.com>, procurement@speedbuy.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week

Hi Logan,

We're ramping to a heavy launch week the week of Aug 10 and expect a ~6x QPS spike for a 48-hour window. Our infra team is okay tuning clients but we'd like Redwood to provide a short-term uplift to avoid throttling.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily increase our quota from 250 QPS to 1,500 QPS for the Aug 10–11 window?
- If we prepay an additional month of committed spend upfront (or take an early-pay arrangement), can we get a temporary rate discount or credit to offset surge charges?

I attached a usage snapshot and the launch forecast. We can share a draft PO if helpful. Time is tight; can we get a proposal today or tomorrow?

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Torres
Head of Platform Operations, SpeedBuy
rachel.torres@speedbuy.com

Attachments:
- speedbuy_usage_snapshot.csv
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@speedbuy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week

Hi Rachel — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. Short answer: yes, we can support a 48-hour uplift, and we have two paths that customers usually take:

1) Provisional headroom + automatic true-up: we open a provisional pool and bill overrun at standard surge rates, then reconcile in the next invoice. Fast to enable (hours).

2) Prepay/commit smoothing: you prepay an additional committed month or take an early-pay invoice; we convert a portion of projected surge into a prepaid credit and apply a temporary reduced surge rate during the uplift window. This reduces unit cost during the peak but requires a PO/commit.

I'll propose concrete numbers after hearing what mix you prefer between guaranteed headroom vs minimal procurement friction. Marissa + Sean — tagging you for pricing and billing language.

Action items for SpeedBuy: confirm the Aug 10–11 window and whether you can sign a short addendum / PO by tomorrow. If yes, we can send a DocuSign addendum and a one-line PO template.

Cheers,
Logan Wright
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@speedbuy.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week

Hi Rachel — good morning. Adding pricing detail so you have something concrete for procurement.

Proposal (option A — fast enable):
- Temporary uplift to 1,500 QPS for Aug 10 00:00 UTC to Aug 11 23:59 UTC.
- Surge/overrun billed at standard short-window rate: $0.045 per 1k tokens over committed baseline.
- No advance commit required.

Proposal (option B — prepay smoothing):
- If SpeedBuy prepays 1x monthly committed spend today (we can accept a PO + early-pay agreement), Redwood will:
  - Convert up to 60% of expected surge tokens into a prepaid credit for the uplift window.
  - Apply a temporary 18% discount on overrun unit rates within the uplift window.
  - Apply a one-time $2k concession credit if DocuSign is returned by EOD tomorrow.

We can also split: partial prepay to cover a guaranteed floor, with provisional headroom above.

I'll attach the surge addendum draft and a PO template for procurement. If procurement needs legal review, our legal can prioritize a one-page addendum.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Pricing, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood_surge_addendum_v1.pdf
- po_template.xlsx
From: Michael Li <michael.li@speedbuy.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@speedbuy.com>, procurement@speedbuy.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week

Logan / Marissa — thanks. Procurement here. Three quick clarifications:
1) If we prepay 1x monthly spend, is the prepaid credit refundable / transferable if actual uplift usage is lower? We need visibility on unused credit treatment.
2) Can you confirm the exact billing SKU for surge so we can map it in our PO?
3) The $2k concession is helpful — can that be applied as an invoice credit rather than a rebate? That speeds internal approval.

We can sign a one-page addendum but need clear acceptance criteria (dates & QPS ceilings) and a PO line mapping. If you can send a DocuSign link and a PO-ready Excel with the SKU, we'll route it today.

Thanks,
Michael Li
Sr. Manager, Procurement, SpeedBuy
michael.li@speedbuy.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Michael Li <michael.li@speedbuy.com>, Rachel Torres <rachel.torres@speedbuy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: temporary QPS uplift + prepay discount for launch week

Great questions — summary and next steps below.

Agreed commercial path: hybrid prepay + provisional headroom
- SpeedBuy will prepay 1x monthly committed spend (applied as a prepaid credit). Any prepaid credit not consumed during the uplift window will remain as a credit balance against subsequent invoices for up to 90 days (non-refundable, transferable only within SpeedBuy's account).
- For Aug 10–11 uplift window: up to 1,500 QPS guaranteed for the 48-hour period. Overrun above the prepaid-covered tokens will be billed at the reduced surge rate (18% off standard short-window rate).
- $2,000 credit will be applied as an invoice credit on the August invoice once DocuSign is complete.
- Billing SKU: RDW-SURGE-SHORTWINDOW (include in PO line).

Docs we will send right now: DocuSign addendum (one-page temporary uplift + credit language) and the PO template with the RDW-SURGE-SHORTWINDOW line prefilled.

Please review and return the DocuSign by EOD tomorrow to lock the $2k concession. If procurement needs a direct legal contact, loop in legal@redwood.com and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — we'll standby to enable the provisional pool once DocuSign is received.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
logang.wright@redwood.com
